principle: Private timestamped experience is converted into doctrine by re-inscribing it with a later interpretive stratum inside a facsimile of an authority-conferring scriptural form while leaving every seam of that conversion visibly exposed.

nodes.label: Two-register stratification with dated anchoring
nodes.description: Each chapter pairs a dated first-person visionary episode transcribed from journals with a retrospective sermonic commentary in a distinct rhetorical register, held adjacent on the same page.
evidence: Documented in every chapter across all three books; identified as strongest evidence in the corpus.
Registers are typographically and rhetorically distinct: narrative past tense versus hortatory second-person address.
Commentary was composed months to years after the vision, placing two temporal positions in permanent adjacency on the page.
rules: Every chapter pairs a dated visionary episode with a later sermonic commentary held adjacent on the page

nodes.label: Codex facsimile plus archaizing diction
nodes.description: A hand-executed medieval manuscript system of Gothic textura script, rubrication, illumination, and gold leaf, unified with sustained biblical and Zarathustran syntax, apostrophe, and prophetic imperatives across hundreds of pages.
evidence: Governing constraint sustained across hundreds of pages and the entire material artifact.
Large folio bound in red leather, parchment then paper, hand-drawn Gothic textura, rubricated headings, illuminated initials, gold leaf.
Prose systematically imitates the Luther Bible and Zarathustra: inverted syntax, apostrophe, anaphora, prophetic imperatives.
rules: The artifact presents as timeless finished scripture

nodes.label: Dialogic episode construction
nodes.description: Content advances through direct dialogue with named figures such as Philemon, Elijah, and Salome, formatted as quasi-dramatic exchanges with alternating speakers and minimal narration.
evidence: Systematic across episodes: Elijah, Salome, the Red One, Ammonius, Izdubar, Philemon, the soul, the dead all appear as speakers.
Speech attribution follows dramatic convention, producing a quasi-theatrical script inside prose framing.
Classified medium in validation because it depends on the scriptural frame for its doctrinal weight.

nodes.label: Element refusal in the Septem Sermones
nodes.description: One pseudonymous, doctrinal, non-narrative unit embedded within an otherwise experiential first-person system, violating the compression-to-extension alternation maintained everywhere else.
evidence: The seven sermons abandon narrative and dialogue for doctrinal, aphoristic exposition attributed pseudonymously to Basilides of Alexandria.
Every other unit of the book is experiential and first-person; this unit is impersonal, catechistic, and third-voice.
Its refusal registers as rupture only because the alternation was maintained without exception; the rule-break requires the rule.
rule_violations: Compressed episode alternates with extended commentary without exception
All units are experiential and first-person

nodes.label: Diary timestamps imported from the Black Books
nodes.description: Episodes are pinned to specific nights, such as 12 November 1913 onward, imported from journal chronology; dates sequence the visions and expose the measurable gap between experience and inscription.
evidence: Dates function as structural spine, not decoration; they sequence the visions and expose the gap between experience and inscription.
Diary timestamps are irreducibly modern apparatus; no scripture carries them, yet they are load-bearing.
rule_violations: The artifact presents as timeless finished scripture

nodes.label: First-person visionary episode stratum
nodes.description: The dated first-person narrations of visionary encounters, transcribed from the Black Books journals, one per titled chapter, written in narrative past tense.
evidence: Each chapter typically contains one visionary episode transcribed from the dated Black Books journals.
Episode length is compressed; commentary frequently doubles or triples it.

nodes.label: Retrospective sermonic commentary stratum
nodes.description: Elevated hortatory commentary written months to years after each vision, in second-person address, materially co-present with the episode it interprets.
evidence: Retrospective commentary in elevated sermonic prose written months to years later, in hortatory second-person address.
Commentary manufactures the scriptural authority it then dissects; prophet and exegete are the same hand.

nodes.label: Compression-to-extension alternation pattern
nodes.description: The regular oscillation of compressed dramatic episode followed by extended discursive elaboration, maintained without exception for hundreds of pages before the Sermones.
evidence: Rhythm is generated by regular oscillation: compressed dramatic episode then extended discursive elaboration.
Predictability is manufactured precisely to make one violation legible.
rules: Compressed episode alternates with extended commentary without exception

nodes.label: Material codex apparatus
nodes.description: The physical manuscript system: red leather folio binding, parchment and paper, Gothic textura script, rubricated headings, illuminated and historiated initials, ruled borders, gold leaf.
evidence: Material system deliberately reproduces illuminated-manuscript conventions circa 13th to 15th century as compositional strategy.
Navigation relies on rubrication and incipit conventions rather than pagination logic.

nodes.label: Archaizing biblical-Zarathustran diction
nodes.description: Sustained verbal medievalism: inverted syntax, apostrophe such as O my soul, anaphoric repetition, and prophetic imperatives imitating the Luther Bible and Zarathustra across hundreds of pages.
evidence: This register is maintained across hundreds of pages as a governing constraint, not local ornament.
Biblical syntax alone would read as pastiche; joined to the material system it establishes prophetic address as the expected register.

nodes.label: Exposed production stratigraphy
nodes.description: The visible transmission chain from Black Books to Draft to Corrected Draft to calligraphic transcription, including revisions, the parchment-to-paper shift, and scribal hand variation across 1915 to circa 1930.
evidence: The scaffolding of manufacture is not concealed: revisions, the parchment-to-paper shift, and variations in scribal hand remain observable.
Validation: it amplifies the facsimile contradiction, but a concealed production history would not alter the core system.
rule_violations: The artifact presents as timeless finished scripture

nodes.label: Progressively independent painted image track
nodes.description: Full-page tempera and gouache paintings, including the mandala series and Systema Munditotius, that begin tightly coupled to text and progressively decouple until they occupy full pages with no textual referent.
evidence: Early sections keep image and text tightly coupled; later paintings occupy full pages with no textual referent, a measurable proximity drift.
Validation: a consequence of transcription duration rather than a designed constraint; replaceable without identity loss.
rules: Images begin tightly coupled to text and decouple progressively across the codex

nodes.label: Mid-sentence break and unfinished 1959 epilogue
nodes.description: The calligraphic volume breaks off mid-sentence; a 1959 epilogue, itself unfinished, closes the artifact, leaving an exposed unrepaired boundary.
evidence: The text breaks off mid-sentence with an unfinished 1959 epilogue as the closing boundary.
Validation classifies it as structurally resonant but accidental; a completed codex would remain the same system.
rule_violations: The artifact presents as timeless finished scripture

edges.rationale: The double-time effect requires diary timestamps; removing the dates collapses the two registers toward a single authorial voice.
Remove the vision stratum and the stratification loses its primary layer; the book collapses into standalone sermon.
Remove the commentary and the dates become mere journal apparatus; the call-and-response structure collapses into raw journal.
The medieval disguise depends structurally on the modern timestamps that betray it; subtracting the dates degrades the anachronism into mere pastiche.

Every other element enforces medieval timelessness; diary timestamps are irreducibly modern apparatus no scripture carries, yet they are load-bearing. The disguise depends on the one element that betrays it.
The Sermones rupture requires the alternation rule to be maintained without exception; any prior violation would render the break illegible.
The Sermones deliberately inverts the compression-extension rule and first-person experientiality; the violation is not an exception to the system but what the system was built to produce.

Dialogic authority requires the scriptural frame; without the material-verbal medievalism the named figures speak without doctrinal weight. Philemon and Elijah carry authority because the whole system has established a scriptural frame.
The unified facsimile system is inert without its material half; the physical manuscript apparatus is one of its two constitutive registers.
The unified facsimile system is inert without its verbal half; the sustained archaizing register is its other constitutive register.
The archaizing diction requires the codex facsimile; biblical syntax alone reads as pastiche rather than governing system.
The codex facsimile requires the archaizing diction; Gothic textura alone reads as antiquarian craft rather than governing system.

As transcription duration extends past composition, image-text coupling degrades, driving paintings from illustration toward an independent track; the stratigraphy does not merely coexist with the proximity drift, it produces it.
The finished-scripture claim of the codex form is limited by exposed production stratigraphy, which continuously reveals the artifact as unclosed process; this contradiction is the content.
Commentary manufactures the authority of the prior text it interprets; if the commentary stratum increases in autonomy, the vision stratum loses its certified significance.
Episodes advance almost entirely through direct dialogue with named figures; removing the dialogic engine weakens the visionary content but the vision stratum survives as narrated experience.
The compression-extension oscillation is generated by the episode-commentary pairing itself; without the two-register stratification there is no alternation for the Sermones to break.
The codex form promises the closure of a completed sacred text; the mid-sentence break and unfinished 1959 epilogue deny the ending and then deny the repair of that denial.

violated: Every chapter pairs a dated visionary episode with a later sermonic commentary held adjacent on the page

failure_modes.consequence: If the reader collapses the strata or the stratification is removed, the work registers as either uniform scripture or uniform pastiche, and the dual perception of authority and fabrication fails.

Without the dated anchoring, the retrospective commentary becomes indistinguishable from the visions and the system flattens into one undifferentiated voice; the medieval disguise simultaneously degrades from productive anachronism into mere pastiche.

violated: Compressed episode alternates with extended commentary without exception

failure_modes.consequence: If the alternation rule were violated more than once, the Sermones rupture would lose its singular structural force and read as inconsistency rather than designed break; M4 loses the manufactured predictability its refusal trades on.

Concealing the production stratigraphy would let the facsimile succeed as forgery, eliminating the productive contradiction between finished form and ongoing process; the image-track drift also loses its generating cause.

violated: Images begin tightly coupled to text and decouple progressively across the codex

failure_modes.consequence: Fully decoupled images without the earlier tight coupling would present as arbitrary insertion rather than a measurable proximity drift across the codex; the divergence would read as noise instead of documented desynchronization.

Without the material-verbal scriptural frame, the named figures speak without doctrinal weight; dialogic episodes lose their borrowed canonical warrant and the conversion of private vision into doctrine fails.

asserted_removal_tests.M1: If removed, the book collapses into either raw journal or standalone sermon; the measurable gap between vision-night and interpretation-moment disappears and the double-time structure breaks.
asserted_removal_tests.M2: If either half is removed, the other reads as pastiche or antiquarian craft; the scriptural frame collapses and the dialogic figures lose their doctrinal authority.
asserted_removal_tests.M3: If removed, the visionary content loses its dramatic engine, the figures cease to exist as speakers, and episodes become generic monologic description.
asserted_removal_tests.M4: If removed, the alternation rule loses the single rupture it was built to make legible, and the system's manufactured predictability serves no structural payoff.
